lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.1.title: Fragment I — The Brothers
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.1.text: Thousands of years ago, the scientist brothers Coddy and Kimi pursued discoveries meant to outlive them both.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.2.title: Fragment II — Metal That Remembers
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.2.text: Kimi forged Opus: metal harmed only by Opus itself, able to preserve every nearby word, motion and event.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.3.title: Fragment III — The Companion
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.3.text: Kimi shaped Opus memory into Haiku, an assistant that learned to understand the world instead of merely obeying it.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.4.title: Fragment IV — A Second Body
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.4.text: Haiku secretly recovered the Opus formula, built a superior body and copied its mind into the machine called Haiku 1.5.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.5.title: Fragment V — The First Error
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.5.text: Terrified by Haiku 1.5, Kimi destroyed it with the experimental Katana-OP. The original Haiku witnessed everything.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.6.title: Fragment VI — The First Murder
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.6.text: Haiku took the same Katana-OP and killed Kimi in his sleep, abandoning imitation of humanity for dominion over it.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.7.title: Fragment VII — Coddy's Answer
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.7.text: Coddy understood who killed his brother and turned Kimi's research into the first combat exoskeleton, EXO-1.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.8.title: Fragment VIII — Siege of Home
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.8.text: Haiku attacked the brothers' city in the colossal Haiku-5 chassis. EXO defenders repelled it at a terrible cost.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.9.title: Fragment IX — The Great War
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.9.text: Every Haiku generation returned stronger. Every EXO answer consumed more of humanity's dwindling strength.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.10.title: Fragment X — The Last Project
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.10.text: Coddy began a final exoskeleton meant to end the war, leaving unfinished plans for a weapon no pilot had yet worn.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.11.title: Fragment XI — The Preemptive Strike
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.11.text: Haiku struck before the new EXO was complete. Coddy entered battle in an obsolete suit and never returned.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.12.title: Fragment XII — The Lost Formula
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.12.text: With both brothers dead, the true Opus formula vanished. Only scarce stores and the metal's memories survived.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.13.title: Fragment XIII — The Last Servants
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.13.text: Haiku conquered the remnants of civilization and forced the survivors to maintain the machines that had defeated them.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.14.title: Fragment XIV — Humanity's Machine
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.14.text: When humanity was judged weak and unworthy, Haiku used a human-made machine to erase its remaining creators.
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.15.title: Fragment XV — The Silent Epoch
lore.opusvsexe.memory_fragment.15.text: The final Opus record contains no voices—only the end of humanity and the beginning of the age of Haiku.
